entry.author: commercecommission
entry.summary:
We hosted this webinar on the Wholesale Supply Inquiry for grocery suppliers on 26 March 2026. 

Watch to hear about the Inquiry and why we are seeking input from suppliers of grocery products. Understand the indicators we are developing to measure the competitiveness of the wholesale market and how they will be used. 

Learn more on our website: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/projects/wholesale-supply-inquiry2/
